description: Set the whole-lot roof style (uint index into Content.WorldRoofs) and pitch (float, clamped server-side to [0, 1.25]). Prerequisite: you are the lot owner (handler-side; server-side Owner via VMTSOAvatarPermissions.Owner — stricter than BuildBuyRoommate). Effect: architecture.RoofStyle and architecture.RoofPitch update for the whole lot. Observable via query-architecture.roof. Cost: free. Wire: VMNetSetRoofCmd { Style, Pitch } on the lot Aries socket. If style >= WorldRoofs.Count the command is silently rejected by the server (Execute returns false).
call_signatures: cf $CF set-roof --style <roof_style_index>                                                              # owner-only; pitch defaults to 0.5
common_mistakes: pitch is clamped to [0, 1.25] silently — out-of-range values are coerced, not rejected.
perception_hints: Am I the owner? perception.lot.owner_is_me — architecture ops are owner-only
Your position (to anchor where to build): perception.avatar.position.x, .y (tile coords — arch ops accept tile coords directly, unlike walk-to)
Walls/floors are NOT exposed in perception — use query-architecture (test helper) if you need pre/post state
refuse_conditions: caller is not lot owner → returns ok:false with 'caller is not lot owner (owner_id=..., me=...)'
required tile coords (x, y) missing → returns ok:false with '<verb> requires x, y ...'
width/height/length <= 0 where specified → returns ok:false with specific bounds error
